tagline: Share selected SQLite tools with response redaction and a session expiry.
requirements: Install uv (which provides uvx). Choose a local database path; the server creates the file if it does not exist. This is the archived reference server. The command constrains the MCP Python SDK to v1 because the archived server is incompatible with v2.

tools.name: read_query
tools.note: Accepts a query string. MCPWire filters the tool name, not the SQL; enforce read-only access in the database/server.

tools.name: write_query
tools.note: INSERT / UPDATE / DELETE against your file.

tools.name: append_insight
tools.note: Writes to an in-memory insight log.
